description: Operator only. Read the persisted OffStereo nightly brief: three proposed stories, two alternatives and the revision/deadline. Reading does not generate stories or approve publication. For a scheduled text, send the selected titles, why-now and listening payoff, alternatives and Pacific deadline. The lineup builds automatically unless redirected before 06:30 America/Los_Angeles.

date.description: Pacific edition date YYYY-MM-DD. Brief defaults to tomorrow; status defaults to today.
